Hyundai Motor India Reports 35% Drop in Q1 Profit

Hyundai Motor India's net profit for the first quarter has fallen by 35%. The decline is attributed to production constraints, a hit to exports, and a supplier fire. The company anticipates a recovery from the second quarter onwards, citing normalized production and a healthy demand environment.
